meta.title: Series & Parallel Routing: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without Tenant Admin, locate Series & Parallel Routing, and verify it is refused or absent.
Repeat the routing action as a Tenant Admin and verify it is available.
Compare the two role outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration.

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin user and the Tenant Admin in the same tenant, test Series & Parallel Routing for sequential and parallel routing, and compare whether the action is refused or available
